# 사잇길부산 / SayItGil BUSAN

> Mother-of-pearl craft workshops with Korean tea in Nam-gu, Busan, South Korea (48526). 부산 남구에서 운영하는 자개 소품 만들기와 다도 체험.

Official website: https://www.sayitgil.net/. Workshops last about 60 minutes and are offered in Korean and English. Guests take home one finished item. Address: 2F, 119 Dongmyeong-ro, Nam-gu, Busan, South Korea (48526). Information updated 2026-10-16; final prices, availability and group conditions must be confirmed at booking.

## Visitor FAQ

### Can I book for one person?
If you are traveling solo, check the booking page for your preferred date and guest count, or contact partnership@sayitgil.net before booking. Availability for one guest must be confirmed for the selected session.

### Is the workshop available in English?
Yes. The workshop is offered in English and Korean.

### How long does the workshop take?
The workshop takes about 60 minutes, including mother-of-pearl craft and Korean tea. Materials and one finished item per guest are included.

### How much does the workshop cost?
Prices per guest are KRW 30,000 for a keyring or bookmark, KRW 35,000 for a hand mirror or business card case, and KRW 50,000 for a coaster. These prices include the approximately 60-minute workshop and Korean tea. Confirm the final price when booking; group rates are quoted separately.

### Can I book a workshop for today?
Same-day availability must be confirmed. Check the booking page or contact us at +82-51-711-0819 or partnership@sayitgil.net before coming to the studio.

### Where is SayItGil BUSAN and how do I get there?
Visit us at 2F, 119 Dongmyeong-ro, Nam-gu, Busan, South Korea (48526). Search for SayItGil BUSAN on Google Maps or Naver Map and use the map directions from your starting point. The workshop is on the second floor.

## Suggested half-day itinerary

Start with an approximately 60-minute mother-of-pearl craft workshop and Korean tea at SayItGil BUSAN. Then explore Oryukdo and Igidae at your own pace and choose a local meal from our Yongho-dong food guide. This is a suggested self-guided half-day itinerary; transport, meals and visits to coastal attractions are separate from the workshop. Check weather, access conditions and restaurant opening hours before setting out.

Yongho-dong food guide: https://partnership-sayitgil.github.io/yongho-food-guide/
